title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
statement_md:
Given an unsorted array of integers `nums`, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence.

You must write an algorithm that runs in $O(n)$ time.

hints.text: Inserting all numbers into a hash set gives O(1) lookup.
Only start counting a sequence if num - 1 is NOT in the set (ensures we only start at sequence heads).
While num + length is in the set, increment length. Each number is visited at most twice.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Hash Set with Sequence Start Pruning
Checking `num - 1 not in set` ensures linear amortized time by only expanding from sequence starts.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(n)$
- **Space Complexity:** $O(n)$
